feature.label: EcTeX - Split LaTeX Workspace
feature.description: LaTeX editor with syntax highlighting and a PDF Preview view. Build with pdflatex and bibtex from the keyboard, and jump between the source and the PDF with SyncTeX (forward search with Ctrl+Space, inverse search with Ctrl+click or Ctrl+Space in the PDF view).
feature.license:

- Apache PDFBox 2.0.31 (https://pdfbox.apache.org/) - Apache FontBox 2.0.31 (https://pdfbox.apache.org/) - Apache Commons Logging 1.2 (https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-logging/)
EcTeX needs pdflatex, bibtex and synctex (MiKTeX or TeX Live) installed on your computer; they are not part of this feature.
